# Black metal tower shield

Internal ID: ShieldBlackmetalTower | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Black metal x8, Chain x4 | Movement speed: -10%

# Introduction

The Black metal tower shield is the fifth tower shield. It has more block power compared to Black metal shield but reduces movement speed by 10% as well as increasing dodge roll cost by 10%.
As a tower shield, it cannot be used to parry enemy attacks.

## Notes

• When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design can not be changed afterward.
